sloka: यदि तद्वक्ष्यते राजा शुभम् वा यदि वाऽशुभम् ।करिष्यसि ततः सर्वमाख्यामि पुनस्त्वहम् ॥२-१८-२५॥
transliteration: yadi tadvakṣyate rājā śubham vā yadi vā'śubham ।kariṣyasi tataḥ sarvamākhyāmi punastvaham ॥2-18-25॥

translations.english: If you fulfil whatever the king says, pleasant or unpleasant, I shall relate to you everything.
